correctness.rationale: Theorem 4.1 gives exact R_k and degree; each 2k+1 branch factor has a distinct geometric root, with exponent +/- binom(2k,j), and infinity has zero valuation by alternating binomial sum. The j=0 valuation -1 gives geometric irreducibility, while a central-binomial induction proves no exponent divisible by 5^(k-1). Tame Kummer local indices and Riemann–Hurwitz prove genus. Lucas digital condition gives exactly prod(d_i+1) totally ramified points and precisely the 5^a / 3*5^a criterion. A smooth rational point and cyclotomic disjointness establish the normal-closure group. The extracted exact checker verifies 192 Binet weight identities, 100 infinity sums, 98 genus and inertia comparisons and 6 fixtures; these do not substitute for proof.

originality.rationale: The primary full text §4 gives the Kummer rational-power model and degree, but no genus, complete inertia profile, base-five maximal-inertia index classification, or Galois normal-closure group. The exact old degree-only analysis is not logically stronger than the new geometric statements. Classical generic Kummer and Lucas theorems supply standard tools; deriving the explicit all-index branch and digit law for the Fibonacci family requires identifying its distinct divisor and arithmetic. Direct earlier coverage was not found in the checked primary text, OEIS listing, or semantic records. Priority uncertainty remains; nonmatching searches do not prove uniqueness.
residual_risks: No historical search proves absolute priority or exclusion of unpublished genus computations.

value.rationale: The coefficients of an integral Fibonacci exponential define a distinguished infinite family of increasingly high-genus curves. Exact genus and complete ramification are motivated invariants beyond already known algebraic degrees. The formula detects all 5-adic binomial carries, and the exact criterion 2k+1=5^a or 3*5^a separates full from partially ramified covers; in tandem with the arithmetic monodromy description this offers concrete data for potential studies of their Jacobians and rational points. No novel general Kummer theorem or nontrivial arithmetic-rank result is claimed. The family has genus 6,54,432,... and a sharp full-inertia upper-genus equality pattern.
